items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Did you ever work with Sun White? Yeah, Sun White. That was Sun White's job that we had when we was on the Washington.

ctx.x: Who is this guy, Joe Benoit? Benoit, sir Benoit. Joe Benoit? Joe Benoit was a drum player.

You were working in there? Yeah, I worked with Joe Benoit, yeah. What time was that? I believe, let's see, Joe Benoit, Joe used to get ordering in jobs. Yeah. He'd get jobs, like this guy, what do they call him, downtown, played trumpet, you know, with talker plenty, and Papa, he's still living, you know who I'm talking about. Joe Benoit and all that bunch used to, he used to live down in North Galveston, last time I remember, and Ron Lichtenfield, last time he was working at the World Island, one of the music…
Oh I see. He never worked with the Chinatown, Sun White.
